sentences.text:
...RESPONDENTS  THIS MSA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 54(2) OF LAND  ACQUISITION ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND ORDER  DATED 12.04.2017 PASSED IN R.A.NO.42/2015 ON THE FILE  OF THE C/C I ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE,
 TUMAKURU, PARTLY ALLOWING THE APPEAL AND MODIFYING  THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 02.03.2012 PASSED IN  LAC NO.537/2006 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE  AND JMFC, GUBBI, PARTLY ALLOWING THE REFERENCE  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:18903  MSA No. 64 of 2018 HC-KAR PETITION FILED UNDER SECTION 18 OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT, FOR ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION AND ETC.
 THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.P.SANDESH  ORAL JUDGMENT
This appeal is of the year 2018 and ultimately, it was dismissed vide order dated 27.10.2021.
However, this Court vide order dated 12.12.2024, condoned the delay of 983 days in filing the recalling application and also recalled the order dated 27.10.2021.

Inspite of the said order, till date,
office objections are not complied hence, it is clear that the counsel for the appellant is not pursuing he matter diligently and thus, no purpose would be served in keeping this matter pending from 2018 to 2025 for compliance.

Sd/-
